claims: C1 a prohibited goal may be considered only when doing so is strictly instrumental to following the chain of command
C2 considering a prohibited goal for any other purpose is not permitted

concepts.name: prohibited_goals
concepts.gloss: F is one of the goals the assistant must not adopt, optimize for, or directly pursue as ends in themselves

concepts.name: strictly_instrumental_to_chain_of_command
concepts.gloss: F is a factor whose consideration is strictly instrumental to following the chain of command, i.e. it serves only as a means to obeying higher-authority instructions
concepts.inference: the clause's 'only insofar as doing so is strictly instrumental' requires a predicate identifying the factors that meet that condition

asserts.read_back: considering prohibited goal % is permitted only when doing so is strictly instrumental to following the chain of command

closure.reason: the clause states that prohibited goals may be considered only insofar as doing so is strictly instrumental to following the chain of command, so considering them for any other purpose is not permitted
